notes.title: Tailypo: Major Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Major update [/b]for January 30th, 2020:

- Made the intro scene in the game much brighter so players aren't easily disoriented.
- While we understand the desire to see a game menu immediately, we designed the game to feel like a film and don't intend to allow players to access the menu until after the intro crawl has displayed upon first play. This may not be ideal for new players who want quick access to a menu, but we promise, the menu is there and fully functional. Just find the cabin! Follow the smoke! ;)
- Improved game mechanics.
- Significantly improved performance.
- Improved visuals.
- Made shadows less expensive.
- Added foliage to winter environment.
- Rebuilt lighting on all maps. We had some significant issues with our lighting builds, and still do, but we've rebuilt lighting across the game as much as possible for the time being. We intend to improve this further, but for now, performance should improve quite a bit. We believe our previous lighting builds were the sore spot for performance issues. If you notice an improvement in performance, please let us know.

This update is live [b]now[/b].

To celebrate these updates we will issue a 50% discount for the week of February 2nd. Enjoy the Super Bowl weekend!

notes.title: New Release Date!
notes.notes:
Due to various unforeseen circumstances, Tailypo's release date has been moved to August 1, 2019! No more delays - we promise!

Enjoy!
